question.text: If the area of the triangle formed by the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math>-axis, the normal and the tangent to the circle <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mfenced><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>25</mn></math> at the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>24</mn><mi>A</mi></math> is equal to _________.

solution.text:
Equation of normal

4x-3y+1=0

and equation of tangents

3x+4y-43=0

Area of triangle=12433+14×7

=12172+312×7

A=122524 Sq. unit

24 A=1225

Note: As positive x-axis was given in the question so question was bonus in JEE Mains.
